items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach, but same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise is scary.
items.why: Meniscus trim; Kubiak day-to-day, Schefter realistic W2 chance.
items.implication: Monitor practice; high TE1 upside if active vs LAC, Mayer loses work.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Harbaugh; status up in air for Week 2 vs Raiders, will monitor how he feels.
items.implication: If out, Tre Harris or others gain routes/targets; monitor Wed practice.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious, day-to-day; would have returned if playoff game. MRI upcoming, coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Hamstring exit after big game; not serious per sources.
items.implication: Likely plays or limited; Bateman/Lane beneficiaries if sits.
items.opportunity: Target share to Bateman/others if out

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities and routes/targets in debut.
items.implication: Every-down RB1 lock ROS in KC offense with Mahomes.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 Utilization Score (99); 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes into 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yds +2 TD. Upgrades to high-end RB1.
items.why: Dominant every-down usage and efficiency in Kubiak scheme.
items.implication: Start as RB1; history supports high PPG with this share.

items.text: Bucky Irving 62% snaps, 58% routes (outpaced Gainwell), 53% rushes, short-yardage lead; 85 Util Score. Upgrades to mid-range RB2; Gainwell mid-RB4 hold.
items.why: Clear lead role including LDD and short yardage despite camp noise.
items.implication: Reliable RB2; fade pure Gainwell shares.

items.text: Etienne only 58% snaps/43% attempts/38% routes in three-way committee even with Kamara out; 14.8 pts inflated by pace. Downgrades to low-end RB2.
Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Extreme core reliance on good offense.
items.implication: Start the four with extreme confidence; fade depth pieces.

items.text: Bucky Irving 8 carries (only GL RB carry inside 10), 21 routes vs Gainwell 13, 7/7 targets. Result overstated but looked healthy; great vs CLE next.
items.why: Out-routed Gainwell, sole GL work, healthy.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; hold over Gainwell.

items.text: Travis Etienne didn't dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/Etienne, 26 Miller, 15 Donaldson; routes 24/7/5; opps 18/9/4. Surprised by committee.
items.implication: Etienne low-end RB2; Kamara return further splits; Miller handcuff/upside.
items.opportunity: Miller gains if Etienne limited or Kamara slow

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0; emerged healthy. Active after pending.
items.opportunity: High target share on limited snaps

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, last night 2.5; only 2 targets (7% share) but 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (near Worthy 30).
items.why: Routes present but volume/aDOT low; needs volume.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; monitor target share ROS.
items.opportunity: High route share if targets rise

items.text: David Montgomery clear RB1 ground (65% attempts, all inside-5, short-yardage) despite 50/50 camp talk and shootout; 79 Util. Upgrades high-end RB2; Marks contingent.
items.implication: Start with confidence as lead back.

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury (fractured, several weeks).
